hypothesis: Replace generic Torch token-major per-head gather/scatter with one Triton gather and one Triton scatter, retaining exactly the held ordering and Q64 support.

modes.permutation: Same-host Torch/Triton input, ordering and buffers; no attention or model claim.
modes.held: Same-host natural Q64, held Torch regroup, held Triton regroup; include gather+identical FA4 alias2+scatter, exclude offline search and first list builds explicitly.

selection: Reuse at most first CPU-accepted historical need state per nominal32K/64K/96K bin from the existing held-regroup gate; no output-based selection.
correctness: CPU permutation/address tests; GPU exact gather/scatter equality with Torch before timings; complete consumer masked IEEE FP32 finite oracle in held mode. No mixed-host addition of component times.
timing: Warm both backends; interleave/rotate repeated CUDA-event timings; count actual held list builds; identical native Q layout, support, QKV and split2. Record reserved GPU seconds and expose all failures.
baseline: Previously published Torch held-regroup negative remains unchanged. Kernel-only wins do not imply request speed or model accuracy.
launch: Commit spec and code, freeze/deploy/bind private inputs, check GPU idle, one worker perGPU, own dyh caches only. Preview seed4 source and schedule unchanged.

tensor_contract.layout: native token-major Q; per-head row permutation

allocation_policy: Both Torch and Triton allocate gather/scatter outputs on every call; same lifecycle.
